# STM32 vendor SDK

This directory holds the ST vendor SDK (STM32Cube HAL/LL + CMSIS) as a git submodule, pinned to a
specific version. Add it with:

```
git submodule add <stm32cube-repo-url> mcu/stm32/vendor/STM32CubeXX
```

Not yet populated — the specific STM32 family (F4, L4, H7, ...) has not been chosen.
